description: On a misty night, river mist beside the Greek ship's rail opens onto a small Danube island. The same dark mist keeps a path back to the deck; when it lifts, the island and the deck lose each other until the next misty night.

crossings.travel: through the river mist beside the rail

scenery.open: River mist gathers beside the rail. Beyond it, a canoe rests on a sandy willow island.

crossings.travel: through the river mist to the ship

scenery.open: Beyond the quiet backwater, river mist parts onto the Greek ship's deck.
